decision: DG-BROWSER option 1 — tracked Playwright devDependency, version-locked probes in this folder (user 2026-08-23)

runtime.requires: npm run dev on ST_PROBE_URL (default http://localhost:5173/) — the QA hooks are import.meta.env.DEV gated

probes.describe: path hit radius is 7px on both axes at every viewport and DPR; no dead strip in the surround
blur / lostpointercapture / pointercancel / Escape mid-drag leave no open transaction, no invalid document, and the next edit still applies
hover promise equals press dispatch where ghost, token and path overlap; repeat clicks are deterministic

probes.covers: structural — motion settings must not reach the tactic
probes.describe: the same pointer script authors an identical tactic with reduced motion on and off
scan line through the ghost: hover key, element under cursor, resolved intent
feedforward promises the subject, one gesture is one undo, the painted board agrees with the clock at rest, mid-playback and on the held result
one press moves editing from one entity path to another; the anti-steal protection survives where strokes overlap

probes.covers: PLAN-015 — 단계 격리 · 테마 · 플링 토글
probes.describe: theme cycles and persists across a reload; step isolation REMOVES a later step's path from the tree (not merely fades it) and restores it when switched off; the ball throw is opt-in and its guide row goes with it

probes.covers: 단계 레이어를 계속 누를 때 단계가 섞이는 문제 (사용자 2026-08-24)
probes.describe: one tactic, then only VIEW ops — number keys, Space, the two replay buttons, the chips, the view toggle, path clicks — in a seeded campaign: the document never changes, isolation never paints another step's path or ghost, the chip agrees with the state, a step pick parks the clock, and every token stands where the clock says
probes.env: ST_PROBE_ROUNDS (default 3) lengthens the campaign; ST_PROBE_SHOTS=1 writes a gallery to pw/lab/out-stepfuzz

probes.covers: 보드가 다른 보드로 바뀌었을 때의 피드백 + 누름 감각 (사용자 2026-08-25)
probes.describe: switching tactic variants makes the board breathe and names which board you are on; every pressable surface gives under the press and springs back

probes.covers: ADR-0009 v16b — 시작 위치 드래그가 선택 개수에 따라 달라지는 계약 (사용자 2026-08-25 문의)
